tagline: Dover Corporation is a diversified global manufacturer and solutions provider delivering innovative equipment and components, consumable supplies, aftermarket parts, software and digital solutions and support services.
hero_kpi_rationale: Consolidated revenue is the primary indicator of Dover's overall performance, reflecting growth across its diverse business segments and being essential to understanding the company's financial trajectory.

kpis.name: Consolidated Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated by the company over a given period.
kpis.description: Consolidated revenue increased by 4.5% to $8.1 billion, driven by 1.6% organic growth, 2.6% acquisition-related growth, and a favorable currency impact of 1.0%.
kpis.signal: Strong growth driven by acquisitions and high-growth markets.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue remaining after deducting cost of goods sold.
kpis.description: Gross margin expanded by 160 basis points to 39.8%, supported by favorable price-cost dynamics, productivity initiatives, and a favorable product mix.
kpis.signal: Improved profitability through effective pricing and cost management.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit expressed as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin improved, reflecting efficient management of operating expenses relative to revenue.

kpis.name: R&D Investments as a Percentage of Revenue
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenses as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: R&D expenses, including qualifying engineering costs, represented 2.0% of revenue in 2025, a slight increase from 1.9% in 2024.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures (Capex)
kpis.explanation: Total spending on tangible and intangible fixed assets.
kpis.description: Capital expenditures are a key indicator of the company's growth and asset maintenance strategy.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of people employed by the company.
kpis.description: Dover employs approximately 24,000 people worldwide, reflecting its global presence and operational scale.

kpis.name: Net Orders
kpis.explanation: Value of new orders received by the company.
kpis.description: Net orders increased by 6.0% to $8.1 billion, indicating robust demand across the company's portfolio.

kpis.name: Dividend per Share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last seven fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of $0.52 in the latest year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last four fiscal years reported.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $0.283 billion in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout Ratio = Dividends Paid / Net Income, calculated over the last four fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Percentage of net income distributed as dividends: 25.9% in the latest year.

risks.title: Economic Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to general economic conditions, recessions, and market fluctuations. This is mentioned multiple times in the 'Business and Operational Risks' section.

risks.title: Competitive Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company faces increased competition in both international and domestic markets, which could impact its sales and operating results. This is mentioned in the 'Business and Operational Risks' section.

risks.title: Regulatory Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to regulatory risks, particularly due to evolving laws and standards. This is mentioned in the 'Risk Factors' section.

risks.title: Human Resources Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company faces risks related to labor costs, labor disputes, and the availability of qualified personnel. This is mentioned in the 'Business and Operational Risks' section.
